report.question_answer: On this Linux worktree the source-extracted surface still names git/node/codex flags and 69 mcp__ ids. Live --help was re-run for git 2.34.1 and node v22.23.2 after a passing valid/invalid detector control. Six vendor binaries and the entire MCP fleet are NOT-CHECKED because they are not on this substrate. That is a substrate gap, not a hand-flipped SUCCESS.

named_probes_verbatim: Probe 1: extract the invoked surface from source (argv arrays, MCP tool identifiers) and execute each binary's --help today, diffing flag-by-flag.

Probe 2 (mechanically different): resolve each MCP tool name against the live tool schema rather than against the docs - the hyphenated vs underscored codex-reply case proves a doc-derived name can be wrong while looking right.
